summary: Vishay Intertechnology filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Shareholders approved Amendment No. 1 to the 2023 Long-Term Incentive Plan, increasing authorized shares by 6.0 million to 12.0 million, extending the plan term by three years, and clarifying option exercise provisions. Directors were elected, and Deloitte Touche LLP was ratified as auditor. This is a routine proxy voting report, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event is disclosed.
